summary: Examines the problems with packet size when tunnels such as IP-in-IP are used in the middle of a network. It covers whether large packets are fragmented and reassembled, whether Path MTU Discovery is used, and how to avoid the problem operationally, and compares solutions. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A tunnel is a narrow pipe, so big packages may not fit. This note looks at ways to cut them up or avoid shipping big ones.
